description.0: A ceremonial artifact formed from the purest ice and snow. Legend has it that generations of Snegovik lords used it in coronation ceremonies until five hundred years ago.

0.0: The equipping character gains "Silver-Tinged Blood Pact": The equipping character's Elemental Mastery is increased by <cryo>24</cryo> for every Cryo character present in the party. For every Electro character present in the party, the equipping character's ATK is increased by <cryo>4.8%</cryo>. Up to 4 Cryo or Electro characters can provide the above buffs.
